gaps.reason: The Field is stored as an integer, and a new record without one joins the end of its list, but positions are not kept contiguous or reordered.
gaps.consequence: Records can be sorted by the stored number; renumbering after deletes, moving between lists, and drag reordering remain work after compilation.
